core_transaction_flows.name: User Registration
core_transaction_flows.transaction_begin: Implicit on first query in request session (get_db)
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Exception raised to FastAPI exception handler (session closed without commit)
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Verification email/OTP dispatch triggered after commit
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: User and profile created atomically in single transaction

core_transaction_flows.name: User Login & Session Creation
core_transaction_flows.transaction_begin: Implicit on first query in request session
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Handled on AuthenticationError (no commit, session closes)
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: None; cookies set on HTTP response object after handler returns

core_transaction_flows.name: Refresh Token Rotation
core_transaction_flows.transaction_begin: Implicit on first query in request session
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after revoking old and creating new RefreshTokenSession
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Session closed without commit on invalid token
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: MEDIUM: Replay detection revokes entire token family in separate commit

core_transaction_flows.name: Password Reset Lifecycle
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after updating password_hash and revoking all user sessions
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: CRITICAL DEPLOYMENT RISK: Table password_reset_tokens is missing from Alembic migrations, causing 500 error on commit

core_transaction_flows.name: Email OTP Verification
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after setting email_verified=True and creating session
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: CRITICAL DEPLOYMENT RISK: Table email_verification_tokens missing from Alembic migrations

core_transaction_flows.name: Case Creation & Participant Initialization
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: AppException triggers handler; session closes without commit
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: Case, owner participant, and timeline event committed atomically

core_transaction_flows.name: Participant Management
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after adding CaseParticipant row and timeline event
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Session closes on authorization or validation error
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: In-app notification created inside same session before commit

core_transaction_flows.name: Document Upload Metadata Initialization
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Presigned S3 upload URL generated in memory before DB record commit
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: If client never uploads binary, Document row remains PENDING_UPLOAD

core_transaction_flows.name: Evidence & Custody Event Creation
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Presigned S3 URL generated before commit
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: Evidence, Version, and initial CustodyEvent committed atomically

core_transaction_flows.name: Evidence Bundle Finalization
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after file assembly and SHA-256 hash calculation
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Storage upload (S3 PUT) executed DURING transaction before db.commit(); storage failure aborts commit cleanly
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW-MEDIUM: Orphaned S3 object if db.commit() fails after successful storage PUT

core_transaction_flows.name: Consultation Booking & Scheduling
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after creating Consultation record
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Session closes on lawyer unavailability or profile error

core_transaction_flows.name: Payment Webhook Processing & Video Provisioning
core_transaction_flows.transaction_begin: Implicit on idempotency check in processed_webhook_events
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after updating Payment, Consultation status to PAID, and provisioning VideoMeeting
core_transaction_flows.transaction_rollback: Session closes on signature verification failure
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Webhook signature verified before starting DB transaction; video room tokens generated in memory
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: Idempotency record and state transition committed atomically

core_transaction_flows.name: Advocate Payout Processing
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after transitioning status to PROCESSED
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: Stripe/Razorpay payout API invoked before commit; if API call succeeds but commit fails, two-phase discrepancy occurs
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: HIGH: Non-transactional external payment gateway call preceding local DB commit

core_transaction_flows.name: Direct Message & Notification Dispatch
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: CRITICAL DEPLOYMENT RISK: Table direct_messages missing from Alembic migrations

core_transaction_flows.name: AI Conversation & Message Generation
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Two separate commits: (1) user message committed immediately, (2) assistant response and audit record committed after LLM completion
core_transaction_flows.external_side_effects_details: LLM inference call (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) executed OUTSIDE database transaction between the two commits
core_transaction_flows.partial_failure_risk: LOW: User message is preserved even if LLM provider fails with timeout

core_transaction_flows.name: AI Human-in-the-Loop Review Adjudication
core_transaction_flows.transaction_commit: Explicit self.db.commit() after updating AIHumanReview status and audit log

external_side_effect_transaction_flows.1_db_tx_start: [VERIFIED] Implicit transaction begins upon first ORM query (Payment query at line 268) within request get_db session.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.2_external_side_effect: [VERIFIED] Stripe REST API call self.provider.create_payment_intent(amount, currency, payment_id, idempotency_key=f"lcc_pi_{payment_id}") at line 297.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.3_db_commit: [VERIFIED] Explicit self.db.commit() at line 314 after self.db.add(payment).
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.4_external_failure_behavior: [VERIFIED] If Stripe API fails (network error, invalid key), an exception is raised before self.db.add(payment). No database record is inserted; session closes cleanly.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.5_commit_failure_behavior: [VERIFIED] If self.db.commit() fails (database error, connection drop, constraint), the database transaction rolls back, but the Stripe PaymentIntent already exists in Stripe.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.6_crash_behavior: [VERIFIED] If process crashes between lines 299 and 314, Stripe holds a live PaymentIntent (pi_...) with no corresponding Payment row in the database.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.7_retry_behavior: [VERIFIED] On client retry, a new payment_id = generate_uuid7() is generated, creating a second independent PaymentIntent in Stripe.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.8_external_idempotency: [VERIFIED] PARTIAL: Provider call passes idempotency_key=f"lcc_pi_{payment_id}", but because payment_id is freshly generated on retry, Stripe treats it as a new distinct request.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.9_database_idempotency: [VERIFIED] NOT IDEMPOTENT: Retried call creates a new row with new UUIDv7 primary key.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.10_outbox_or_reconciliation: [VERIFIED] NONE: No transactional outbox or scheduled reconciliation worker reconciles uncommitted Stripe PaymentIntents.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.11_compensating_cleanup: [VERIFIED] NONE: No try/except block calls stripe.PaymentIntent.cancel(provider_payment_id) upon DB commit failure.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.12_orphaned_external_resources: [VERIFIED] YES: Orphaned Stripe PaymentIntents remain in Stripe dashboard until expiration (requires_payment_method expires after 23 hours).
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.13_duplicated_external_ops: [VERIFIED] YES: Rapid client retries can produce multiple active Stripe PaymentIntents for the same consultation.
external_side_effect_transaction_flows.14_webhook_repair: [VERIFIED] NO: If the user completes payment on the orphaned Stripe intent, the incoming webhook fails with ResourceNotFoundError("Payment not found for provider ID") at line 514.
